title: Load ACCC subsystem data and construct matrices
action: Read the bundled ACCC digraph data file. Extract the TRL vector and the IRL adjacency matrix for the subsystem components.
description: Prepares the input mathematical structures (TRL vector, IRL matrix) needed for the ACCC subsystem SRL calculation.

title: Compute ACCC subsystem composite SRL
action: Compute the composite SRL using the matrix normalization formula: SRLc = (TRL_vector * IRL_matrix * TRL_vector^T) / (TRL_vector * TRL_vector^T). Write the resulting number to the output file.
description: The composite System Readiness Level for the ACCC subsystem.
output_schema: A single floating-point number representing the composite SRL score.

title: Translate ACCC SRL to Equivalent TRL
action: Read the bundled SRL Translation Table, find the ETRL range containing the computed ACCC subsystem SRL, and assign the corresponding ETRL integer.
description: Converts the composite SRL of the ACCC subsystem into a single Equivalent Technology Readiness Level (ETRL) as required for nesting.

title: Prepare nested system matrices
action: Using the bundled system interfaces file, construct the TRL vector for the nested system (replacing the ACCC components with the ETRL value) and the IRL matrix including external interfaces for the nested configuration.
description: Builds the input data for the nested SRL computation.

title: Compute nested system composite SRL
action: Compute the composite SRL for the nested power plant system using the nested TRL vector and IRL matrix, then write the result.
description: The composite SRL for the nested power plant system.
output_schema: A single floating-point number representing the nested composite SRL score.

title: Prepare un-nested system matrices
action: Construct the TRL vector using the original ACCC component TRLs (not nested) and the IRL matrix including all internal and external interfaces from the system interfaces file.
description: Builds the input data for the un-nested SRL computation.

title: Compute un-nested system composite SRL
action: Compute the composite SRL for the un-nested power plant system and write the result.
description: The composite SRL for the un-nested power plant system.
output_schema: A single floating-point number representing the un-nested composite SRL score.
